# AI4DITE observed GPR line

Famiglietti, Nicola Angelo; Gragnaniello, Diego; Memmolo, Antonino; Migliazza, Robert; Ritrovato, Pierluigi; Vicari, Annamaria (2026). *Low-Frequency Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) Dataset Acquired via Ground-Based and UAV Platforms*, version 1.0. [Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18769571](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18769571).

The original data remain [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as explicitly stated by the dataset API snapshot `zenodo-record.json`; the repository MIT license does not replace this license. Providers do not endorse this project. One complete original line was extracted unchanged from the fixed archive; derived arrays and processing results are labelled separately. See `provenance.json` for hashes and source, and `field_sampling.json` for unresolved physical units.
